

# label.exe is all Rust (label-rust) and cargo links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/label-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C stays on disk, uncompiled.
# The translated C, kept on disk:
# label.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/label-rust/src/label/label.rs)
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
add_library(label_shims OBJECT rust_varargs_shim.c)
target_compile_definitions(label_shims PRIVATE UNICODE _UNICODE)
# The resources are the one thing cmake still compiles, in this OBJECT library
# whose windres command the cargo link replays.
add_library(label_res OBJECT label.rc)
target_compile_definitions(label_res PRIVATE UNICODE _UNICODE)
target_include_directories(label_res PRIVATE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR})
add_cargo_module(label label-cargo label.exe
    KIND win32exe
    BODY_CRATE label-rust
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS label_shims label_res xdk)
